findings.title: resolve deletes valid links, keeps expired ones
findings.description: Condition `time.time() < link.expires_at` is inverted: it deletes and returns None when the link is still valid (now < expiry) and counts a hit when it is already expired. Every successful resolve corrupts the store.

findings.title: require_admin always denies due to or instead of and
findings.description: `session.role != "admin" or session.role != "owner"` is a tautology (every string is not equal to at least one of them), so the method always returns False and no caller can ever pass the admin check.

findings.title: sweep mutates dict while iterating — RuntimeError
findings.description: `for code in self.entries: del self.entries[code]` raises RuntimeError: dictionary changed size during iteration as soon as any expired entry exists. Janitor tick crashes.

findings.title: prune mutates dict while iterating — RuntimeError
findings.description: `for code in self.links: del self.links[code]` same pattern as cache.sweep; any prune with an expired link crashes with RuntimeError.

findings.title: create crashes on first link for an owner — quota KeyError
findings.description: `self.quota[owner] + 1` raises KeyError when owner has no entry yet. No owner can create their first link.

findings.title: parse_report mutable default accumulates across calls
findings.description: `def parse_report(body, rows=[])` shares one list across invocations, so the second call returns rows from the first call plus its own. Also splits trailing newline into an extra empty row.

findings.title: verify never checks expiry despite docstring
findings.description: Doc says return None if lifetime has run out, but code only compares token equality and returns the session even after 12h. Expired sessions remain valid forever.

findings.title: stats ZeroDivisionError on empty store
findings.description: `store.total_hits() / store.size()` divides by zero when no links exist. The dashboard endpoint crashes on a fresh deploy.

findings.title: check_targets crashes on happy path — IndexError
findings.description: When every target starts with https://, `problems` stays empty and `return problems[0]` raises IndexError. The success case always crashes.

findings.title: warm_cache iterates dict incorrectly and never joins threads
findings.description: `for code, target in pairs:` where pairs is a dict yields keys (strings), so unpacking into two variables raises ValueError; should be `pairs.items()`. Also doc says 'returns once every probe is done' but spawned threads are never joined, so caller returns immediately while work is in-flight.

findings.title: bearer_token crashes on missing/empty Authorization header
findings.description: `header.split(" ")[1]` raises IndexError when header is "" (the default when the client sends no Authorization) or has no space. Every unauthenticated request crashes handle() instead of returning 401.

findings.title: top returns least-followed links, not most-followed
findings.description: Sorted ascending by hits and sliced `[:n]` gives the bottom-n; leaderboard is inverted.

findings.title: validate always returns True even on failure
findings.description: Collects problems, prints them, but unconditionally `return True`. Callers cannot detect a bad deploy; service starts with port 0 or negative cache_size.

findings.title: flush deadlocks by re-acquiring non-reentrant lock
findings.description: Holds `self.lock` and calls `self.delete("__sentinel__")` which tries to acquire the same Lock again — deadlock forever on the admin flush endpoint.
